stage: written after frozen v1 duplicate/cost rejection and before v2 comparisons
incumbent_evidence: R24 normal-model EMA divided by its frozen threshold
rule: If weak evidence arrives while incumbent normalized evidence is at least 0.8, hold it pending. Consume pending evidence if incumbent alarms first. Otherwise release when normalized evidence falls below 0.8, with a finite 100-sample ceiling. Weak evidence below the approaching gate reports immediately. Incumbent output is never muted.
gates: same zero-false, strict-event, +5 active-sample, tool, tail, sign and nearby gates as v1
